children: The US Treasury's auction on Thursday of $115 billion in 4-week bills yielded a high rate of 4.05%, awarding 57.47% of bids at that rate, according to Treasury data.
The 4-week bill auction saw a bid-to-cover ratio, a measure of demand, of 2.55.
